verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated first-party webhooks docs page stating that webhooks let you react to process events, sandbox lifecycle changes and file modifications. That is a product-native event subscription capability, not a chat-app integration. The pack quotes only a single line, though, so the registration mechanics and delivery guarantees go unshown. Missing for 10: details on endpoint registration and filtering, payload schema, signing/verification, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks allow you to react to process events, sandbox lifecycle changes, and file modifications.
